description: Email a one-time verification code to an address (sign-up, sign-in, confirming an email). email59 makes the code, sends it, limits resends and expires it; the code is never returned to you. Returns an id. Uses 1 email of today's allowance. A new code to the same address replaces the one waiting there. Then call verify_check with what the person typed.

app_name.description: Your app's name, shown in the subject and body. Optional.

code_length.description: Digits in the code, 4 to 10. Default 6.

expires_in.description: Seconds the code works, 60 to 3600. Default 600.

from.description: Name before the @; the domain is always email59.com. Default verify.

name: verify_start
title: Send a verification code
